title: LOCALIZED CONCEPT ERASURE IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE DIFFUSION MODELS VIA HIGH-LEVEL REPRESENTATION MISDIRECTION
reasoning: The paper presents a technical method (HiRM) for erasing specific concepts (like nudity or certain styles) from text-to-image models. While it discusses safety and harmful content, it focuses on the technical mechanism of unlearning rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
